description: Admin triage view for pending mcp_submissions. Portal exists at mcp_submission_portal.html but admin review surface does not. Must: (1) query pending submissions via :8781 registry_api, (2) display mcp_name, requested_by, submission_date, current_verdict, (3) allow analyst to APPROVE/CONDITIONAL/REJECT with reason field, (4) write to mcp_decisions table via write_service. Target port 8790. X-API-Key auth required.
